title: SAYSD1 senses UFMylated ribosome to safeguard co-translational protein translocation at the endoplasmic reticulum
model: 293T ER-GFP-K20 reporter cells, GeCKO v2 (A+B) genome-wide knockout library
contrast: GFP-high vs GFP-low FACS sort (2 vs 2 repeats)
paper_method: MAGeCK (paired mode); 234 genes at p < 0.01, 88 high-confidence by STRING network
paper_calls: 88 high-confidence hits; UFMylation cluster (UFM1, UBA5, DDRGK1, CDK5RAP3, UFSP2) and SAYSD1
barcs_calls: 299 genes at FDR 0.10 (30 enriched in GFP-high); 21 against the control null
named_hits: 3/6 at FDR 0.10 (DDRGK1 #6, SAYSD1 #23, CDK5RAP3 #26); UFM1/UBA5/UFSP2 enriched but miss
verdict: BARCS recovers SAYSD1 (the paper's validated lead) and the translocon/splicing/translation signal, and 2 of the 5 UFMylation genes; UFM1, UBA5 and UFSP2 are enriched but miss FDR because only part of their guide set responds.
